scope: Readable portable reconstructions of read-only chunk handling, model-resource key processing, engine frame-kind names, candidate-result decisions and model-file header/first-table reads; not original source or binary-compatible replacements.

source.naming: All reconstructed names and API choices are ours, not recovered developer symbols.

coverage.subset: Read-mode end seek to measure input length, then beginning seek. Archive opening and the original open/write flags are not implemented.
Decode little-endian 6-byte header; end = header position + total size; push current end; report ID. Boundary exhaustion is handled by this API rather than a caller loop.
Bound reads by the active chunk end and require the requested byte count. This reconstruction also bounds reads at depth zero.
Read-mode seek to the current end, then decrement nonzero depth; depth zero uses file size. Write-mode backpatching and optional written-size output are excluded.

additional_components.name: model_resource_key
additional_components.subset: String-content effect of the model name's backward last-dot scan, not the surrounding resource loading/cache behavior.

instruction_anchors.observation: Initialize backward scan from string length
Compare the current character with a dot
Write a NUL at the last dot

additional_components.behavior: Preserve case, whitespace and separators; remove the last dot and everything after it anywhere in the string. No dot leaves the content unchanged.
intentional_differences: std::string/string_view replace the game's copy-on-write string representation.
Accept decoded non-NUL string contents, explicitly rejecting embedded NUL rather than modeling inconsistent length metadata or truncation.
No resource directories, file suffix addition, cache management, engine calls or successful model load is reconstructed.

verification.limitations: All current real sample names lack dots. Last-dot edge cases are supported by static assembly plus synthetic tests, not execution of the original routine.

additional_components.name: frame_kind
additional_components.subset: Numeric enum and names for the 16 supported kinds. Unknown values return an empty optional rather than reproducing the engine's formatted fallback.

additional_components.name: model_load_policy
additional_components.subset: Candidate-result branch decisions and two diagnostic categories. No retry loop, logging, cache or engine loader.
intentional_differences: Pure decision object exposes the action and diagnostic instead of branching or logging.
Accept unsigned 32-bit result bits and test the high bit without implementation-defined signed conversion.
No original SDK names are assigned to unexplained status codes.

additional_components.name: model_file_header
additional_components.subset: Only the first 16 bytes and signature/version/first-table count checks, not a complete original function.
intentional_differences: Borrow a caller-owned stream at its current position instead of opening a DTA member or changing global engine state.
Use typed exceptions instead of the original negative status codes.
Reject every incomplete prefix explicitly; original dtaRead calls do not consistently check returned read lengths.
Preserve eight metadata bytes without assigning an unverified date/time meaning.
Use a neutral first-table entry count name; a complete table or authoritative material interpretation is not reconstructed.

additional_components.name: model_first_table
additional_components.subset: Read first-table serialized fields only, preserving original flag bits, opaque payloads, conditional raw name bytes and optional sequence fields.
intentional_differences: Caller-owned stream replaces global archive state; no engine object allocation or resource requests.
Reject all incomplete fields and counts above the shared 6000-entry limit explicitly.
Preserve absent optional fields separately from present zero-length fields, and preserve embedded NUL/non-ASCII bytes.
Do not reproduce runtime flag mutations, generated sequence names, renderer options, playback or reference counting.
Payloads and sequence parameters remain opaque; no authoritative material-type labels are invented.

verification.limitations: The extended-payload path is supported by assembly and synthetic fixtures, not these real samples. No original routine is executed.

intentional_differences: Caller-owned seekable std::istream replaces the game's archive handles.
Exception-based error reporting replaces Boolean results.
Reject incomplete/invalid headers, parent overruns, file overruns and failed seeks explicitly.
Enforce a 256-level safety limit consistent with the inferred end-stack capacity, not an observed original runtime guard.
Support files only within signed 32-bit offset range, using wider arithmetic internally instead of reproducing overflow.
No DTA lifecycle, writing, chunk-size patching, original object layout, engine calls or game execution.

verification.limitations: Synthetic behavior and independent file traversal checks, not differential execution against the original x86 routines. The C++ scanner does not validate name payloads or decode gameplay semantics.
